sources.title: Most Common Last Names In Brazil
sources.scope: Brazil-only ranked surname entries transcribed and manually curated; single-token surnames and established prepositional forms; no concatenated multi-surname full-name strings
sources.limitations: Forebears is a third-party incidence model, not IBGE official census. The source contains some full-name-like combinations; those were excluded. Accent-folding removes equivalent variants; some common first-name-shaped items are also listed as surnames by source. Source licence/redistribution needs review before production.

sources.title: Surname Dispersion Dataset, locatefamily.com crawl (Sajjad Pourali)
sources.scope: Independent Brazilian source for corroboration of newly added entries; not used to assign probabilities.
sources.limitations: Third-party scraped address-directory data with some company names and given-name contamination; candidate entries filtered and preferably corroborated by a second country-specific dataset; licenses and individual attestations remain subject to review.

sources.title: Nomes e sobrenomes do Brasil (Caique Dourado): surnames from Brazilian CNPJ partner registry
sources.territory: Brazil: registered company partners in CNPJ (Brazilian Federal Revenue registry)
sources.period: Underlying corporate-register data used by 2023 project; public repo 2026 snapshot
sources.scope: 27,047 extracted surnames, 17,361 single-token overlaps with July 2019 Brazil-tagged locatefamily listing. Added entries selected from the intersection; company partner occurrence counts excluded.
sources.limitations: Source extracts words after first given name, not formally labeled family-name spans; may include additional given names, particles and business text. New additions filtered to single Latin tokens and require appearance in both national corpora. Descriptions generated by AI are not used and cannot establish etymology or authenticity. Data file CC BY 4.0 with attribution; review person-level examples before release.
sources.attribution: Caique Dourado, Nomes e sobrenomes do Brasil, CC BY 4.0; https://github.com/CaiqueDourado/brazilian-names-surnames
